correctness.rationale: The stationary generator equations for f=X_i² and f=S X_i² give m_{i,1}=D_i/κ_i, m_{i,0}=D_i/κ_i+D_i/q. Predictable jump compensator yields μ_i=κ_iD_i/2. The explicit corrector h_i(0,x)=κ_i x_i²/2, h_i(1,x)=-κ_iD_i/(2q) obeys Lh_i=μ_i-g_i in each state and turns both signed work jumps into the same constant-magnitude q-independent c_i=κ_iD_i/(2q). Thus M_i=W_i-μ_iT+h_i(end)-h_i(start) is a martingale; its continuous quadratic covariation is diagonal (independent Brownian B_i), while shared q-Poisson jumps produce q c_i c_j T deterministically. Stationary isometry gives exact Cov M=T Sigma. Square-integrable stationary boundary corrections are O(1), giving physical-work covariance-rate limit. Ergodic bracket plus bounded jumps gives multivariate martingale CLT. Identical-particle sum yields 2NκD²+κ²D²N(N+8)/(4q). Independently tested nine exact rational generator, moment and bracket identities in three parameter settings; not a substitute for the ergodic limit proof.
